d:
Advocate Jagjeevan Khanna places a trespassing board in Gokuldham Society on behalf of his client, Mack Associates. He serves a notice claiming the builder constructed the society without an NOC and demands ₹50 crore within 21 days or eviction.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
